# Dog notes

## Biscuit

Eats one cup of dry food twice a day. Frightened by thunder, so leave the radio on low at night.

## Rufus

Eats two cups of dry food twice a day. Likes to share a run with Juno.

## Juno

Eats two cups of dry food twice a day. Ear drops, three drops in each ear, every morning.

## Moss

Eats three cups of dry food once a day, in the evening. Allergic to chicken, so no chicken treats.

## Pip

Eats half a cup of wet food and half a cup of dry food once a day, in the evening. One joint tablet with the evening meal.
